C-PROTOCOL-IMPORT-349.Summary: Complete issue 349: tolerant protocol recognition, batch correction and versioned format profiles.
C-PROTOCOL-IMPORT-349.Problem: Separate agenda and hearing blocks are confused with numbered resolutions. Bulk upload exists but has no shared correction or tested format editor.

Goals.Goal: Recognize numbered and ordinal references, section variants and bounded label typos without rewriting business text or inventing dates.
Import independent files, edit only exceptions, preview and version shared recognition formats, then reprocess selected sources safely.
Preserve originals, extracted history, manual overrides, transferred or removed questions and previously generated documents.

Constraints.Constraint: Exact base main is acb44aacf4084c2bbc0c0c79a032e63f098109eb; issue 349 is the acceptance authority.
Keep SQLite schema 31, applied migrations, dependency versions, release version and deployment unchanged. No mandatory LLM or network.
Keep persistProtocol and issue 348 transfer semantics; append final recognition to the existing worker pipeline and retain the base extraction.
Shared profile writes require manager/admin and source edit access; correction reads/writes retain document access and existing authentication/CSRF boundaries.
Use the existing templates table with a separate protocol_recognition kind, immutable profile versions and explicit scope matching; exclude these from generic template application.
No motion and no adaptive learning of consequential actions or document text. Preserve failed-row drafts and expected-update checks.
Reuse ordinary project CI and the existing meetings browser workflow; no temporary workflow, probe commit or duplicate unit gate.

NonGoals.NonGoal: New release or offline installer changes.
Replace the output DOCX template editor or automatically delete previously imported questions.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: The representative document yields three questions with matching resolutions, preserves numbered sub-decisions and excludes signature rows. The invalid day 00 requires correction, not a date from the body.
Profile preview is read-only; save is versioned and idempotent, rejects stale/invalid inputs, and only matching files use aliases.
Batch metadata correction saves valid rows independently; errors and stale edits retain user input and have an actionable retry.
Reprocessing keeps source hashes and prior extraction JSON, protects manual changes and clears, does not recreate transferred/deleted questions and rolls back on forced failure.
Parser and real DOCX/API/worker regression pass; desktop and mobile exercise real upload, partial correction, profile preview/save and repeat import with normal actions.
Only exact-head relevant CI and GRACE gates are required before expected-head squash merge; main then runs its existing post-merge smoke.

VerificationIntent.ExpectedEvidence: Protocol regression tests, existing meeting continuity tests, exact-head CI and an unchanged migration/dependency tree.
